summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Keep private and preview-only. Woot API documentation proves access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict those uses. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness progress: 0/4 SearchWoot tasks closed; all four remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing for field-level rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle covering rights, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident/request inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; missing written permission or an API agreement and field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending a read-only data-flow and retention table covering identifiers, Slack delivery, deletion, correction, access, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request evidence.

Fleet compliance disposition: technical baseline is 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; this is not legal certification. Do not treat incomplete analytics as zero or as an automatic growth blocker. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, security, rights, privacy, claims, or launch evidence is missing. Continue only bounded reversible work within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action for each site is a dated readiness packet containing ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.
